subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Last note from me on the lapsed-rider win-back for {Brand}, after my earlier email on completed-ride optimization and the shift toward re-booking your own base. If incremental rides and refund-adjusted volume are on your roadmap this quarter, I can share the city-level segment breakdown and a short holdout plan this week. If the timing is not right, I will leave it here and step back. Either way, you have the context for when it becomes useful.
register_notes: Stage 3 EN ride_hailing retargeting (Australia): references prior email and earlier stages so the cascade reads as one thread; direct close with an easy out (releases the prospect if timing is wrong); no MobUpps figure; zero question marks; {Brand} and RECIPIENT_NAME kept; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y'; native business register.
